# Readable

> Write in Markdown. Get a page worth sharing.

Readable is a free tool that converts Markdown into beautifully formatted, shareable pages. Write or paste Markdown in the editor, see a live preview, hit Publish, and get a clean URL — no setup, no account required.

## What Readable does

- Turns plain Markdown into a formatted, readable web page
- Provides a permanent public URL (shareable link) for every published page
- Renders GitHub-Flavored Markdown: headings, code blocks, tables, lists, task lists, blockquotes, Mermaid diagrams, and KaTeX math
- Auto-generates a Table of Contents for documents with 3+ headings
- Supports YAML frontmatter (title, author, date, tags, description, password)
- Live preview in the editor as you type
- Multiple named drafts, auto-saved to browser localStorage
- 9 built-in templates (incident report, ADR, postmortem, runbook, release notes, etc.)
- Export to Markdown, HTML, or PDF from the published page
- Per-page analytics: views, read depth, referrers
- Version history: restore any of the last 10 publishes
- Password-protected pages
- Custom URL slugs for signed-in users
- Permanent pages (no expiry) for signed-in users; anonymous pages expire after 30 days

## REST API

Readable has a REST API for programmatic publishing:

- `POST /api/v1/publish` — create a new page, returns `{ id, url }`
- `PATCH /api/v1/pages/{id}` — update an existing page in place (same URL)
- `GET /api/v1/pages` — list all pages owned by the authenticated account
- `DELETE /api/v1/pages/{id}` — delete a page permanently

API keys are generated from the My Pages dashboard after signing in (free).

Full reference: https://readable.ashwinsathian.com/api-docs

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Readable has a native MCP server that lets Claude and other MCP-compatible AI assistants publish pages directly in natural language.

MCP endpoint: `https://readable-mcp.ashwinsathian.com/mcp`

Setup instructions: https://readable.ashwinsathian.com/mcp-setup

To add Readable to Claude Desktop or Claude.ai, add this to your MCP configuration:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "readable": {
      "url": "https://readable-mcp.ashwinsathian.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

## CLI

```
npx readable-cli publish README.md
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/readable-cli

## Pricing

Free. No paid plans. No credit card. Every feature is included with a free account.
Anonymous publishing (no account) works immediately with a 30-day page expiry.
Signing in (free) upgrades pages to permanent and unlocks the full feature set.

## Technical details

- Built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Published pages stored on Cloudflare KV via Cloudflare Workers
- No user content is indexed for training or resold
- XSS-safe: all content is rendered through a custom AST renderer (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML on user input)

## Templates available

- Incident Report
- Post-Mortem
- Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
- Runbook
- Release Notes
- Engineering Proposal
- Meeting Notes
- Onboarding Guide
- Weekly Status Update
